svg.title: Harness map: in-product-agents layer
svg.desc: In-product-agents harness. Lossless on the left, The Collaborator on the right, artifacts grouped by category. Most pairs are similar. Three lines are missing on our side: a tiered simulator, run-to-run replay and live-model preflights. One is missing on their side: a source-of-truth rule between a coding-agent command and its in-product copy.
